name: Juli Sikorska, PhD
headline: Futures & Imagination, Systemic & Experiential Interventions, Collectives | Co-Founder Urban Heat Studio
summary:
Juli is a transition designer and researcher. She is a founding member of the Urban Heat Studio and a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Applied Arts in Vienna. She gathers people to break down barriers between climate impacts and structures of injustice today that make societies brittle. 
Juli creates playful, immersive interventions for people to work through uncomfortable emotions, change perspectives about barriers and opportunities, and build new stories together that spark radical action. 

Juli brings 15 years of experience across climate, strategy, design and the arts. She has researched sustainability transitions with EU CreaTures and MIT Climate CoLab, her works have been exhibited internationally including the Design Museum (UK) and neue Gesellschaft für Bildende Kunst (GER), and she has taught systems thinking and more-than-human design futures for students in sustainable development, art and design.

Comedy Café Berlin is Berlin's 1st international, alternative comedy stage, bar & training school.

I play regular shows as a performer and member of a house team, an improv group that showcases the best of what CCB offers.
From time to time, as a house manager and show tech I coordinate between show producers, performers and bar staff to ensure that the evening's events start on time. In the past, I have also served guests behind the bar.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Member
positions.description:
We are an imagination collective for transformative climate resilience. We gather people together to break down the time barriers between climate impacts tomorrow and the structures and injustices today that make us brittle in the face of planetary-wide change.

We create playful, immersive experiences for people to work through uncomfortable emotions, change perspectives about barriers and opportunities, and build new stories together.

🌆 From 2021-2023, we have run HeatCon, an annual gathering for climate practitioners and creatives to embody wildly resilient futures.

Our partners are people interested in creating more resilient cities, and with it more just and joyful livelihoods. Some of them come from climate and resilience organizations such as Climate KIC, social organizations like the German Red Cross, some from creative institutions such as the German Government’s Centre of Excellence for the Cultural and Creative Industries and Neue Gesellschaft für Bildende Kunst. And sometimes the city is the "client", and we gather the right resources to make it happen.

positions.title: Guide
positions.description:
Stone Soup is a participatory community of enthusiasts, makers and doers bound by a shared passion for the application of Experience Design to life, profession and societal impact. The community is concentrated around 3 to 4-day Experience Design Conferences that serve as a participatory platform for skills sharing, co-design and experimentation of new ideas. It's usually frequented by professionals and non-professionals from the fields of Experience Design, Storytelling, Facilitation, Service Design, Consultancy, Business, Art but also Molecular Science, Computer Science and Quantum Physics. The non-profit is completely founded on decentralized and cocreational principles. 
I've guided newly formed experience design teams to co-create experiences following the core principles of Do-Acracy, Flexible Hierarchy, Radical Interdependence, Inclusion, Transparency & Honesty, Reflexive Learning, and Safety.

positions.title: Strategic & Experience Design Lead
positions.description:
As a strategic & experience design lead, I support organizations building digital products and services, help them transition towards socially and environmentally sustainable structures, and lead design processes. I think in systems, not single users, and translate uncertainty into tangible experiences.

I have consulted for fortune 500 companies, early stage tech startups and non-profits, leading teams through the design process. This led me from researching and exploring possible futures to designing experiential scenarios, through understanding people across all stakeholder levels and exploring current business opportunities, to designing (digital) services and ventures and evaluating them – e.g. for financial services from European institutional investors to individuals in urban and rural Tanzania.
